meta.title: Testnet Connection & Basic Order Flow
meta.epic: 10 - Live Trading Production Readiness & Lighter.xyz Integration

story-context.story-summary: Validate testnet connectivity and basic order submission for at least one exchange to prove the system works with real exchange APIs.

acceptance-criteria.criterion: Connection to testnet established with valid credentials, account info retrieved
Limit order submission works (submit, verify in open orders, cancel)
Market order submission and fill works (submit, fill received, position updated)
Rate limit handling verified during order submission
Tests skip gracefully if credentials are not available

key-tasks.task: Implement limit order test (submit, verify, cancel)
Implement market order test (submit, fill, position)
Implement credential skip logic with descriptive messages

architecture-context.constraint: Rate limiting must be active during tests

technical-specifications.spec: skip_without_hyperliquid_creds = pytest.mark.skipif( not os.environ.get("HYPERLIQUID_TESTNET_API_KEY"), reason="Hyperliquid testnet credentials not available" )
Use minimum sizes (e.g., 0.001 BTC) to avoid depleting testnet funds. Use unlikely limit prices that won't fill. Close any positions opened during tests.
